title: Premium Computation Sheet — Collateral Protection Insurance on Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
**When no premium is booked.** No collateral protection premium is booked on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans product that does not place collateral protection, on a loan that is no longer open, being paid off, declined or not yet funded, or when a collateral protection premium was already booked less than 12 whole months before the placement date.

**The premium.** The collateral protection premium is the product's collateral protection annual percentage of the principal balance on the placement date for one year of coverage (365 days), figured once and rounded to cents.

## Inputs and their records

| Input | Record it is read from |
|---|---|
| Annual percentage | the product's collateral protection annual percentage in its insurance schedule |
| Principal balance | the loan's principal balance on the placement date |
| Earlier premium | collateral-protection fee entries in the loan's transaction history, by date |
| Loan status | the loan's status on record: open loans are those in active, deferred or nonaccrual status |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A Truck & Trailer Loan (annual percentage 6.5) with a principal balance of 42000.00 on the placement date: 6.5 percent of 42000.00 for one year is 2730.00, and that is the premium booked.

A second hypothetical: a principal balance of 18345.67 gives 6.5 percent of 18345.67, which is 1192.46855, rounded once to 1192.47.

## The 12-month interval on both sides

Hypothetical placement date 10 September 2026:

| Earlier collateral protection premium dated | Whole months before the placement date | Premium booked now |
|---|---|---|
| 11 September 2025 | less than 12 | no |
| 10 September 2025 | 12 | yes, if the other conditions hold |

## Loans on which no premium is booked

| Loan | Premium |
|---|---|
| Product that does not place collateral protection (every product of the line other than the Truck & Trailer Loan) | none |
| Loan paid off, declined or not yet funded | none |
| A collateral protection premium already booked less than 12 whole months before | none |
